title: 3 stars because it's adorable, minus two because...
text:
3 stars because it's adorable, minus two because.... It loses 2 stars because one of the wires wasn't connected and the light didn't work. I did fix it myself, but will have to get my son to fix it correctly for me. The wire will have to be soldered to be sure it's correct and safe.

I would buy again, if they make sure it's not broken. It's adorable and comes with three plush elf head ornaments.
